description: This file defines API routes for managing shopping cart functionalities in a food ordering system using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for adding, retrieving, updating, and deleting cart items, along with internal utility functions for calculating subtotal and enriching cart item data.

methods.name: float _compute_subtotal(items: list[CartItem])
methods.description: Calculates the total price of the items in the cart by summing the product of price and quantity for each item.

methods.name: list[CartItem] _enrich_cart_items(repo: SupabaseRepository, raw_items: list[dict])
methods.description: Enriches raw cart item data by attaching menu item details fetched from the repository.

methods.name: AddToCartResponse add_to_cart(payload: AddToCartRequest, ctx: AuthContext = Depends(require_auth))
methods.description: API endpoint to add a menu item to the authenticated user's cart, creating or updating an existing item.

methods.name: CartResponse get_cart(ctx: AuthContext = Depends(require_auth))
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve all cart items for the authenticated user.

methods.name: CartItem update_cart_item( item_id: str, payload: UpdateCartItemRequest, ctx: AuthContext = Depends(require_auth) )
methods.description: API endpoint to update the quantity of an existing cart item.

methods.name: None delete_cart_item(item_id: str, ctx: AuthContext = Depends(require_auth))
methods.description: API endpoint to remove an item from the user's cart.

ctags.name: add_to_cart
ctags.pattern: /^def add_to_cart(payload: AddToCartRequest, ctx: AuthContext = Depends(require_auth)) -> AddToCar/

ctags.name: delete_cart_item
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_cart_item(item_id: str, ctx: AuthContext = Depends(require_auth)) -> None:$/

ctags.name: update_cart_item
ctags.signature: ( item_id: str, payload: UpdateCartItemRequest, ctx: AuthContext = Depends(require_auth) )
